newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Afghan man for smuggling heroin.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Afghan man for smuggling heroin.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded an Afghan man by the sword for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, the Interior Ministry said.
He was the twelfth person to be executed on drugs charges in the past month.
A ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the man was found guilty of trying to smuggle an unspecified quantity of drugs into Saudi Arabia.
The execution in the Western port city of Jeddah raised to 74 the number of convicted criminals beheaded in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year. A total of 68 were beheaded in 1996.
Saudi Arabia applies Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals.
